      "snippet": "You’re correct: you shouldn’t be the one guessing paths. The runner should locate your MetaBlooms OS root automatically and then run from the right place.
So I shipped a no-guessing “find root + run hook” Termux script that:

searches shared storage for candidate MetaBlooms roots

scores them (looks for ./metablooms + entrypoints like BOOT_METABLOOMS.py, RUN_METABLOOMS.py, boot_manifest.json)

selects the best match

runs the hook runner against that path

Download
Download 2026-01-11_MB_FindRoo"
